checkpoint.title: Indigo Plateau's Mart: Full Restores before the Elite Four

events.why: from the nurse across the lobby to the Mart's counter, facing the clerk (0, 7) across it (1, 7)

Full Restores up to 13 in the bag, as in PokeGuy's bag at Lorelei (fullrestore x13, potion x4, superpotion x4, xaccuracy x3, xspecial x15, xspeed x4, guardspec x2, elixir x1; PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, lorelei): the C policy's heals in the League's five fights come from the bag. Buys 13 less what the bag holds (3000 each), skipped at 13; a short purse stops the row here, before the League

2 Full Heals (600 each) at the same counter after the Full Restores, only if the money left covers them (user's decision 2026-11-15: keep the Full Restores at 13 and their money check; the Full Heals are extra): not in PokeGuy's bag at Lorelei (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, lorelei: antidote x1 and parlyzheal x2 only, which 19.01a buys): they cure the sleep and freeze those don't without spending a Full Restore. if_affordable: a refused buy, or a quantity box that can't reach 2, is skipped with a log line and the row goes on. The console buys blind (no money reader), so there the skip is the game's refusal dialog passed by the presses, not a read

checkpoint: Starts at Indigo Plateau's nurse, where 19.05 ends with the party healed. The Mart is its own row, as 19.01a is for the Route 22 rival: 20.01 starts at the counter with the bag as Lorelei needs it.
Ends at the counter (2, 7) facing the clerk, where 20.01 starts.
